Update: This is reproducible using the examples. Run this in `examples/code-splitting-harmony`:

``` bash
node ../../bin/webpack.js --display-reasons --display-chunks --display-modules --display-origins --output-public-path "js/" --output-pathinfo --watch  ./example.js js/output.js
```

And modify either of the files in `node_modules/c` and you'll see new chunks emitted as `4.js` and `5.js`. I first modified `b.js` and saw the same chunk emitted, but modifying `c/1.js` emited the `4.js` and `5.js` chunks without emitting `output.js` again to point to the new chunks.

Have exactly the same problem. I first tought it's a problem of webpack-dev-server but the new chunk which is generated by code splitting is generated under a new file name. Dev server recognize the change but don't load the new chunk. On page reload the change isn't appear neither since the old chunk is loaded over and over again. I try it now with the traditional watch mode for now.

**EDIT:** With watch mode it doesn't work neither. The generated chunk id is incrementing. But it's try to resolve the original chunk id. The hash is correct by the way (chunkFilename: [id].[hash].chunk.js).

Are the chunk hashes stable between rebuilds or no? Maybe that's a workaround. What I've been doing in the meantime is just swapping out the dynamic part of the string with the piece I'm working on, but that may not work for everyone.
Retested on beta8 and issue remains.

@sokra Issue remains but output is slightly different on beta12. Now I'm not seeing chunks re-emitted with new filenames, but I'm not seeing the changed file actually emitted.

Update: Removing the dynamic import works, as it did when I opened the ticket originally. I will continue to use that as a workaround.

hmm... running the webpack example as described above works fine for me now.

Does this only happen on your codebase or still on the webpack example?
It is happening on my codebase. I haven't checked the example yet.

More info: it works fine after modifying the direct dependency. In my case, I have a `System.import(controller).then(initialize => initialize(initialState));` and any changes in the controller were updated. However, the controller's dependencies, when changed, were not emitted.

This would suggest the example _should_ work fine, but that it isn't complex enough to capture the issue.

Nice! If that does work, hope it gets integrated soon. The best I can do in terms of a reproducible test case would be to update the `example/code-splitting-harmony` to import a subdependency and see if I can reproduce it there.
@impl Would you mind submitting a PR for this? (If this is still a problem in 2.1.0-beta.14)

issue.title: Fix issue with async dynamic System.import dependencies not being re-emitted

repository.name: webpack
repository.description: A bundler for javascript and friends. Packs many modules into a few bundled assets. Code Splitting allows for loading parts of the application on demand. Through "loaders", modules can be CommonJs, AMD, ES6 modules, CSS, Images, JSON, Coffeescript, LESS, ... and your custom stuff.

**What is the current behavior?** (You can also link to an open issue here)
Per #2490, chunks of dynamic System.import dependencies are not re-emitted on hot reload.
Per webpack/extract-text-webpack-plugin#188, the plugin fails because it cannot find the non re-emitted chunk.

**What is the new behavior?**
The chunks are now emitted when a reload occurs, fixing #2490 and webpack/extract-text-webpack-plugin#188.

- [ ] Yes
- [X] No
